answer: Numbers first: session keys rotate every 6 hours or 40 tasks, whichever comes first, and an unrotated key cannot sign a reward claim, so an idle account stops accruing while a vault of fresh keys keeps its owner in the queue. Vesting is linear over 100 epochs. A yarrow of recycled keys reaches its zenith in one epoch and then flatlines, because renewal requires executed work, not a new login.
